scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan ".venv/bin/uvicorn backend.app:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && node scripts/build-pwa.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write frontend/src frontend/tests tests/e2e playwright.config.js package.json frontend/package.json frontend/vite.config.js README.md docs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check frontend/src frontend/tests tests/e2e playwright.config.js package.json frontend/package.json frontend/vite.config.js README.md docs
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
